ITEM.PTXT: A warning light for 4WD control is provided in the combination meter. The light illuminating, blinking or going off, and the display on the multi-information display, inform the driver of the operating condition of the 4WD system and any system malfunction.

ENTRY.PTXT: Informs the driver of the 4WD auto mode control status by illuminating the light. When 4WD auto mode is ON, the light blinks 2 times and then illuminates, and when 4WD auto mode is OFF, the light goes off. In addition, if excessive driving during 4WD control may damage the drive system, the light blinks and the vehicle switches to front-wheel drive.
Informs the driver of a 4WD system malfunction by illuminating the master warning indicator light and displaying it on the multi-information display.
Illuminates or blinks at the same time as the malfunction is displayed on the multi-information display to warn the driver.
